author: SUBMITTED
title: Jazz duo sets stage at Mainstay on Saturday - NewsBreak
text:
By SUBMITTED ,
20 hours ago
ROCK HALL — The Mainstay presents an unforgettable evening of world-class guitar artistry as renowned jazz virtuoso Frank Vignola joins forces with longtime collaborator Vinny Raniolo for a special duo performance on Saturday, May 9 at 7:30 p.m.
Widely regarded as one of the leading guitarists in contemporary jazz and swing, Vignola has performed with legends including Bucky Pizzarelli, Wynton Marsalis, Mark O’Connor and Donald Fagen. Alongside him, Raniolo brings his own exceptional talent and a dynamic musical partnership that has been praised for its technical brilliance and engaging style.
Together, the duo delivers a captivating program of swing standards, gypsy jazz favorites and inventive arrangements, marked by dazzling technique, seamless interplay and moments of intimate musical conversation. Set in the warm, close-up atmosphere of The Mainstay, this performance offers a rare opportunity to experience two master guitarists in a pure duo format, with the focus entirely on the music. Tickets are $25 in advance and seating is limited.
